subject: Policy Update — Family Changes
body:
Dear Herr Müller,

I hope you had a good summer! I am writing because there have been some important changes in my family situation that I believe affect my insurance policy.

My partner and I got married in August, and I now have two stepchildren (ages 8 and 11). I would like to update my life insurance policy to include them as beneficiaries and potentially increase the coverage amount.

Also, we are thinking about retirement planning now that we are a family of four. Could you send me information about family-oriented retirement savings plans? I want to make sure the children's education is also covered.

I'd prefer to handle all of this over email if possible — my schedule has become quite hectic with the new family dynamic, and I find it easier to respond to emails at my own pace.

Thank you so much for your continued support.

Warm regards,
Maria García López
